videotrim.drop: Drop a video here or click to choose one
videotrim.label.result: The cut — check it, then download
videotrim.status.idle: The video only ever opens inside your browser — nothing is uploaded.
videotrim.err.open: Your browser could not open this video. mp4 and webm usually work.
videotrim.err.unsupported: This browser cannot capture video. Try Chrome or Edge.
videotrim.err.empty: Nothing was captured. Try a slightly longer section.
videotrim.say.loaded: {name} · {len} — pick the section and hit cut.
videotrim.say.recording: Capturing… {left}s left (the section is actually played while capturing)
